name: me
purpose: A Prism of its owner, generic until the owner's own content fills it in their browser. Send a facet and its fields: boundary decides whether a labeled fact may move, learn moves a belief's weight on a signal, when relates two intervals. Anything else is refused.
placeholder: boundary public none browser none no no

promise.headline: Nothing of yours leaves your browser unless the proved Boundary allows it.
promise.detail: Every request is routed to the facet that decides it, and each facet's guarantees are proved in Lean 4: nothing moves while halted, nothing goes to GitHub or the hosted verifier, and nothing goes out without your approval.

claim: PM-01: the Prism answers a request naming a known facet with exactly that facet's decision of the rest, and refuses every other request.

proposition.name: routes
proposition.text:
route facetBoundary rest = PrismBoundary.dispatch rest
route facetLearn rest = PrismLearning.dispatch rest
route facetWhen rest = PrismChronology.dispatch rest
route facetUnknown rest = refusal
proposition.plain: Each request is answered by the facet it names, and only by that facet.

theorems.name: routesBoundary, routesLearn, routesWhen, refusesUnknownFacet
theorems.statement: route facet rest = that facet's dispatch rest, and refusal for an unknown facet
theorems.how: Proved by linear arithmetic over the facet codes, checked by the Lean kernel by prismpm verify in CI

theorems.name: Boundary inv001Holds to inv007Holds
theorems.statement: deny while halted, deny to GitHub, deny to the verifier, never allow detected or restricted data, never outbound without approval, never an identifier outside the browser
theorems.how: Proved by linear arithmetic for every request, axioms Quot.sound and propext only

theorems.name: Learning inv001Holds to inv008Holds
theorems.statement: only the owner confirms or rejects; confirmed and rejected beliefs hold; weights stay within bounds
theorems.how: Proved by linear arithmetic for every request, axioms Quot.sound and propext only

theorems.name: Chronology inv001Holds to inv008Holds
theorems.statement: no Allen relation the endpoints contradict; well-formed intervals are never malformed
theorems.how: Proved by linear arithmetic for every request, axioms Quot.sound and propext only

pinned.name: prism_pm_01 to prism_pm_04
pinned.what: Each theorem's exact statement and axioms, that every guarantee is about the facet's own judge, and that the application's answer is decided by route. A string-matching test, not a theorem: a planted defect fails it.
